goal: Document-ready mutation'ını kalıcı ve aynı workspace kapsamındaki match/approval kararını zorunlu kılacak şekilde bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin ready wiring ve testini geri al; karar, belge, ödeme ve teslimat verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Ready mutation requires a durable decision row bound to the same workspace, document and invoice
Request-body match/approval values cannot create or authorize ready without the durable decision
Duplicate ready remains idempotent and decision conflict remains fail-closed
No PII, provider secret or provider raw response is added to the decision or public route
